name: Major-Power Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Major-Power Technology Co., Ltd., an enterprise specializing in the design of analog integrated circuits (ICs), delivers Hall sensor technology and a variety of analog power management components. Operating from its base in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, the company serves clients both domestically and across global markets. Established in 2011, its product portfolio notably includes buck, boost, and Hall ICs, specifically engineered for deployment in LED applications.
